verdict.rationale: Vercel documents serving optimized images 'from the CDN' and offers ISR/edge middleware, implying CDN-backed static asset delivery, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a global edge network, cache-control/edge caching mechanics, or performance benchmarks/independent corroboration of CDN speed.
